commands: 1. hosted read-only audit: uv run sig-ops evidence-audit --dsn $SIG_HOSTED_DSN --capture-dir <mounted OCFL root> --seed <recorded> --sample <recorded> --out <live-audit>/
2. recovery plan: uv run sig-ops recovery-plan --audit <live-audit>/audit_report.json --out <live-audit>/
3. operator review pause (1-4 h): the operator reviews the plan and fixes the apply scope — the apply never starts on silence

4. bounded apply — pilot first: uv run sig-ops recovery-apply --dsn $SIG_HOSTED_DSN --plan <live-audit>/recovery_plan.json --audit <live-audit>/audit_report.json --apply --execution-id <recorded> --authority <operator-auth-ref> --capture-dir <mounted OCFL root> --verify-rerun --rematerialize --out <live-apply>/ -- with --max-actions and a --batches/--claims selection inside the pilot ceiling (<= 500 claims, <= 50 MB)
5. approved batches: the same command per approved batch (each <= 10,000 assertions, <= 250 MB distinct bytes, 1 worker)

6. unpublished freeze: uv run sig-ops recovery-freeze --dsn $SIG_HOSTED_DSN --apply-report <live-apply>/APPLY_REPORT.json --plan <live-audit>/recovery_plan.json --audit <live-audit>/audit_report.json --out <live-apply>/

dispatch note: on the ACT-13 exec host steps 1-6 run as sig-exec-{audit,recovery}-<stamp> one-off Cloud Run jobs rendered by sig-ops exec-host run --purpose {audit,recovery} (ops/exec_host.toml) with a read-only captures mount; the --dsn form above is the contract's command surface

pilot.detail: the pilot batch is <= 500 claims and <= 50 MB; a first failure after 50 writes pauses; the pilot is the first batch and it stays the smallest

batch.detail: each approved batch: <= 10,000 assertions, <= 250 MB distinct bytes, one worker

storage_headroom.fractions: warn at 0.7 used, require a disposition at 0.85, keep >= 0.2 free per batch (B16 / NEW-9)
storage_headroom.basis: G1 inventory — sig-pg allocates 15 GB SSD with autoresize on and limit 0 (unbounded); GCP counts GB in decimal
storage_headroom.re_read_rule: the byte figures are absolute; the leg re-reads bytesUsed/bytesAllocated at run time and, if the allocated figure differs, recomputes the same fractions on the read allocation and records the recomputed bytes in the run ledger — a batch never starts below its free floor

ceilings.job_ceilings: the exec-host job itself is CPU 1, memory 512 Mi, timeout 1800 s, max-retries 0 (ops/exec_host.toml) — absolute under AR-9

verification_checklist: the audit's hosted population digest reconciles with the plan's before any write
applied actions are a subset of the plan, digest for digest — no action outside the plan, no byte outside the capture
receipts are unique — the apply is exactly-once across restarts

no fetch path is used — a missing byte can only produce a skip; nothing is reconstructed as old evidence
rematerialize is dependency-ordered and a +0 no-op on re-run
the snapshot records frozen_unpublished — it is never published by this row
hosted /health and the required surfaces stay green during and after
the disk before/after read (bytesUsed/bytesAllocated) is recorded at the leg — the contract's catalog AC
explicit_reservations: the open live deferral stays OPEN; this row closes its production-recovery half only when the packet executes — the final post-evaluation candidate half stays owed through the human-evaluation path (P35.62)
no source-rights flip, no publication, no HG gate tick, no human label
